All Rights Reserved Worldwide." and since 2023-05-11 adds "This is now in the public domain", linking Berean's terms. Those terms (https://berean.bible/terms.htm, dated April 30, 2023, read 2026-10-27) say: "The Berean Bible and Majority Bible texts are officially dedicated to the public domain as of April 30, 2023." and "All uses are freely permitted." They do not itemize the interlinear glosses; applying the dedication to them is an inference. The 2026-10-27 release check (spec-chirho/research-chirho/26-10-27-release-license-check-chirho.md) found no current rights claim on the interlinear's own pages (interlinearbible.com, which shows a "Free Licensing" link, and the biblehub.com interlinear). Berean also asks that the Berean name not be used for derivative works that vary from the official text.
sources_chirho.attribution_chirho: English glosses from the Berean Interlinear Bible (https://interlinearbible.com), extracted to Nestle 1904 word ids by biblicalhumanities.org (https://github.com/biblicalhumanities/Nestle1904). Adapted here: glosses joined to Nestle 1904 words by osisId, each join guarded by NFD equality of the Greek word; glosses are shown as given, including "-" for a word left untranslated. No endorsement is implied.

sources_chirho.title_chirho: Berean Interlinear Bible English glosses keyed to Nestle 1904 words (glosses/berean-interlinear-glosses.xml)
sources_chirho.license_chirho: Public domain as stated, not CC0. glosses/README.md first carried "The Holy Bible, Berean Interlinear Bible, BIB, Copyright 2016 by Bible Hub, Used by Permission. All Rights Reserved Worldwide." and since 2023-05-11 adds "This is now in the public domain", linking Berean's terms. Those terms (https://berean.bible/terms.htm, dated April 30, 2023, read 2026-10-27) say: "The Berean Bible and Majority Bible texts are officially dedicated to the public domain as of April 30, 2023." and "All uses are freely permitted." They do not itemize the interlinear glosses; applying the dedication to them is an inference. The 2026-10-27 release check (spec-chirho/research-chirho/26-10-27-release-license-check-chirho.md) found no current rights claim on the interlinear's own pages (interlinearbible.com, which shows a "Free Licensing" link, and the biblehub.com interlinear). Berean also asks that the Berean name not be used for derivative works that vary from the official text.
sources_chirho.attribution_chirho: English glosses from the Berean Interlinear Bible (https://interlinearbible.com), extracted to Nestle 1904 word ids by biblicalhumanities.org (https://github.com/biblicalhumanities/Nestle1904). Adapted here: glosses joined to Nestle 1904 words by osisId, each join guarded by NFD equality of the Greek word; glosses are shown as given, including "-" for a word left untranslated. No endorsement is implied.
